description: Answer-level evaluation set. `answerable` reuses question ids from retrieval.json (same wording and expected sources) and adds `answer_must_include`: a list of groups; every group must contain at least one alternative (case-insensitive substring) in the answer. This checks that required facts appear, not that the prose is good. `unanswerable` questions have NO answer in eval/corpus: 'far' ones are off-topic, 'near' ones are on-topic but ask for a fact the corpus never states. Authored by hand before any run.
